﻿Building Resilient Systems (Park, Sonia)
- Your Highlight on page 28 | Location 332-336 | Added on Friday, April 17, 2026 10:01:10 PM

The process of decomposing a complex system into smaller modules is called modularization. Each module encapsulates a specific function, reducing interdependencies and making the overall system easier to maintain and evolve.
==========
﻿Building Resilient Systems (Park, Sonia)
- Your Highlight on page 29 | Location 347-351 | Added on Friday, April 17, 2026 10:03:07 PM

There are two main approaches to fault tolerance: redundancy-based and recovery-based. They differ in how they handle failures. Redundancy-based tolerance uses duplicate components to mask faults, while recovery-based tolerance detects failures and restores normal operation through rollback or restart.
